content: Size of a length field for a chosen structure The attribute sizeOfStructLengthField of SOMEIPTransformationProps defines the size of a length field generated by the SOME/IP transformer in front of the struc- ture for which the DataPrototypeTransformationProps is defined according to [TPS_SYST_02121].
